As wel talked about, qemu doesn't have host bios emulation, nor MCTP support, so I'm not sure how this would test anything.  Please test on gb200 and verify that the bios attribute transfer works, and values are correct for that platform.

On any platforms, BIOS emulation cannot be performed. So the required files are transferred on qemu and testing is performed. 
I dont think we can have any way where we could emulate the qemu for bios.

No need to emulate, just use a real system.  Please work with M2 and I if you're unable to find one.

This code appears to have broader applicability and could be useful in other contexts as well. Moving it to a generic utility would make it more accessible and beneficial for others. It may be a good candidate for inclusion in a separate patch set.
